_comment: GENERATED — run `node game/tools/sync-audio-manifest.mjs` after adding or removing a file rather than editing this by hand. Anything not listed is treated as silent, so the game always plays with or without audio. A voice id is a strings.js key path (act1.wake -> voice/act1.wake.m4a). An sfx id is its path under audio/sfx/, and for characters the FOLDER is the voice: everything under npc/tribe/ is one pool the game picks from at random. Save as plain UTF-8, no BOM.
